text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick Q — traveler booked an Airbnb for a 5-night offsite and the host charged an extra cleaning fee mid-stay (host invoice attached). They paid with company card but Airbnb shows the charge as a separate host invoice and a platform fee. How should we expense this?

Carlos M: Platform fee (service fee) is non-recoverable. The host cleaning fee is OK if its part of the reservation invoice and business-related. Does the host provide an itemized invoice with VAT?

Nina (People Ops): host sent a PDF invoice that lists cleaning fee and nights, no VAT number. The Airbnb payment record shows two line items: accommodation + cleaning. Company policy says always prefer company card booking for Airbnb, but this was booked on company card.

Finance Bot: Guidance: 
``
- If company card paid: attach Airbnb reservation confirmation + host invoice if available.
- Expense category: "Lodging - Short Term Rental"
- Platform fees (Airbnb service fees) are expenseable but non-recoverable for VAT purposes.
- If host invoice lacks VAT, Finance cannot reclaim VAT; still reimbursable.
- For separate mid-stay charges, include host invoice and the Airbnb payout/receipt showing charge and date.
```

Hannah K: what about receipts for reimbursement to the host (if host asked traveler to pay cash)? different story, but not this case. Also confirm whether we allow cleaning fees above X%?

Legal Desk: Policy: reasonable cleaning fees are allowed. If cleaning fee seems excessive (>20% of total lodging), escalate to People Ops + Travel Ops. Provide justification (special cleaning due to event, pets, etc.).

Nina (People Ops): thanks — host cleaning =  45 (approx 12% of total). I'll accept. Any special note text to put in expense form?

Travel Ops Bot: Recommended expense note: "Airbnb reservation [confirmation #], nights 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-15. Host invoice includes cleaning fee  45 (see attached). Company card charged on 2026-09-10."

Finance Bot: Also add charge code/cost center and attach the Airbnb policy screenshot showing refund/cancellation terms if relevant. Submit within 14 days for quicker processing.

Carlos M: one extra nuance  if the host invoice is a direct bank transfer request (host prefers bank), do NOT pay host directly from employee personal funds. Use Procurement/Travel Ops to handle vendor payment.

Nina (People Ops): perfect. I'll message the traveler with the checklist and approve the claim. Thanks! :thumbsup:
